newsitem.title: USA: Eight HMOs, VHA form health care alliance.
newsitem.headline: Eight HMOs, VHA form health care alliance.

text.p: VHA Inc, a health care services firm, said it and eight provider-owned health maintenance organizations have formed an alliance.

The alliance's eight founding members that cover more than one million people combined include Health Net, Health Partners of Alabama, HealthPartners Health Plans, PARTNERS National Health Plans of Indiana, PARTNERS National Health Plans of North Carolina, Physicians Plus Insurance Corp, Priority Health, and Sentara Alternative Delivery Systems.

The company said the alliance will enable the firms to boost purchasing power and the company's can learn from one another. None of the companies in the alliance are in direct competition with one another, VHA said.
Initially, the Alliance will focus on care management, networking and education, product development and services that can be purchased collaboratively and marketing the alliance to new members.
